# {{ site.first_name }} {{ site.last_name }}: publication summaries and abstracts

Homepage: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}

Structured catalog: {{ '/publications.json' | absolute_url }}
Bibliography: {{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}

The records below are publication summaries and citation records, not full papers.
They include complete author lists and available abstracts of the linked works.
Editorial summaries and sourced answers explain their scope; full-paper links lead to the original text.
Publication types distinguish preprints, proceedings papers,
journal articles, chapters, and software releases; an arXiv version of a published paper is linked
within that paper's record. Bibliographic details come from the site bibliography, with the HCII
abstract transcribed from the linked author-hosted PDF.
